description: Searches jwatte.com articles, downloadable kits and website tools together and returns up to 10 results. Each result has an id, a title and its canonical https link, plus its kind (article, download or tool), the publication date for articles, and a short summary. A question about the newest articles is answered by publication date, newest first.
